description.value: Two Rivers Gallery is a public art gallery situated on the traditional and unceded territory of the Lheidli T'enneh, dedicated to contemporary Canadian art and lifelong learning through the arts in Prince George and the Central Interior. The gallery hosts rotating exhibitions, artist programs, and a shop featuring work by artists and artisans from Western Canada. It is a significant cultural landmark in northern BC and a worthwhile stop for cyclists touring through Prince George.
